## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
my_penguins <- penguins

avg_bill_len <-  my_penguins |> 
  drop_na() |>
  group_by(
    species
  ) |>
  summarize(
    avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm)
    )
```

```{r}
ggplot(my_penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(
    title = "Palmer Pengiun Bill Length vs. Flipper Length by species",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    color = "Species"
    
  )
```
